name: Kijō (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kijō town emblem in yellow: a crown-like device above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kijō, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 April 1974.

features.role: Kijō town emblem — a crown-like device above a ring
